units: <cite ref="Sukkah 34a:7">Succ. 34ᵃ</cite> <he>חילפא ג׳</he> a willow with rounded leaves.

<cite ref="Shabbat 110a:8">Sabb. 110ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Menachot 42b:16">Men. 42ᵇ</cite> (<cite ref="M00000"><he>מ</he></cite>)<he>גביא ג׳</he> (v. <cite ref="M00108"><he>מַגַּבְיָא</he></cite>) liquid alum in rounded form (στυπτηρία στρογγύλη, v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Stypteria).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:25">Targ. Job XIII, 25</cite>.—
<cite ref="Chullin 46b:2">Ḥull. 46ᵇ</cite> a feather, spittle, <he>או ג׳</he> or a piece of straw.
<cite ref="Chullin 56b">Ib. 56ᵇ</cite> top <he>ג׳ דחיטתא</he> a piece of wheat straw.

<cite ref="Niddah 26b:36">Nidd. 26ᵇ</cite> <he>דרמינן ליה בג׳ דחטתא</he> on whom we may throw wheat chaff, i.e. embarrass with petty questions.—Pl. <he>גִּילֵי</he>, <cite ref="C00974"><he>גִּילֵּי</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 41:20">Targ. Job XLI, 20</cite> sq.—
Succ. 14ᵃ בגִילַיְיהוּ (grains) in their haulms.—בֵּי גִּילֵּי dumping ground, marsh. גילדנא דבי ג׳ the small fish living among the reeds in the swamps.
